title: *CS611 GDB SOLUTION*
text:
*CS611 GDB SOLUTION* 

*Answer:*
*No* The project manager is not correct. The crashes did not have zero cost to the company.

Although the company paid no fines or refunds during the week of the outage, cost is not limited to direct cash outflow. The poor app store ratings caused a steady drop in new downloads and market share over the next six months. This is a real economic loss in the form of lost future revenue, lost customers, and damaged reputation / goodwill.

In cost concepts, this is *opportunity cost and intangible / indirect cost*. The company lost the revenue it would have earned if the crashes had not happened and its ratings had remained good. Fixing the bug for free does not erase the loss of trust and market position.

Therefore, the total cost of the crashes is greater than zero
